name: Fieldstone Store
description: AI-agent-operable storefront: search the catalog, manage a cart, and read totals.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the product catalog by free-text query and/or price range.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Fetch full details for a single product by id.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a quantity of a product to the shopping cart.

tools.name: remove_from_cart
tools.description: Remove a product, or a quantity of it, from the cart.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Read current cart line items, item count, and subtotal.

note: This file is a discoverability aid only. Tools are actually registered at runtime in the browser via document.modelContext.registerTool / navigator.modelContext.registerTool — a static manifest cannot execute tool calls on its own.
